01Company Overview

A design and manufacturing services partner for global OEMs

We work alongside OEM engineering teams on equipment programmes — reviewing intent, developing the design, sourcing components and assembling the machinery. Because design and manufacturing sit under one roof, every drawing is shop-floor validated.

Design Office

Full CAD/CAM, 3D modeling, FEA, and manufacturing detailing.

Workshop Works
